entities.summary: Arthur Bernard Langlie was an American politician who served as the mayor of Seattle and was the 12th and 14th governor of the state of Washington from 1941 to 1945 and from 1949 to 1957. He is the only mayor of Seattle to be elected governor of Washington, the longest serving Governor of Washington, and the only governor in the state's history to serve non-consecutive terms.
